Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

Proximal FrontierSWE · access terms: The pinned repository provides task specifications and digest-pinned images for evaluation, directs users to per-task upstream attribution, and warns that task/scoring content may change.

Permanent record ID: candidate.mandatory19.cohort4.benchmark.frontierswe.access-attribution-and-limit

  • Source-version-bound creator disclosure; private author-only candidate, with no approved scientific independence, new family coverage or supplier-relationship credit.
  • Individual task terms and complete payloads remain unread; Proximus’s evaluation-aware design remains an acknowledged limitation.

  • Source-version-bound creator disclosure; private author-only candidate, with no approved scientific independence, new family coverage or supplier-relationship credit.

Permanent record ID: candidate.mandatory19.cohort4.benchmark.frontierswe.score-and-budget-protocol

  • Source-version-bound creator disclosure; private author-only candidate, with no approved scientific independence, new family coverage or supplier-relationship credit.
  • This versioned partial-credit protocol differs from v1 details; a six-task native-harness ablation is not a full benchmark-wide harness equivalence test.

  • Task categories, v1/v2 repositories, traces and mirrors do not create independent family counts; the pinned README says task content and scoring may still update.
